name: Zoom the live globe by sea: Planet, a sea, then a watched region (signed in)
description: Validates the /live tiers: the globe opens at the Planet tier with the busiest seas counted, a sea row flies down to the Sea tier with its own card, breadcrumb and address, Planet flies back up, and a shared link opens the Baltic whose Gulf of Finland row reaches the Strait tier.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-live-03+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /live and wait up to 60 seconds for the globe (data-testid live-globe-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the tier box (data-testid live-tier) has data-tier "planet", and in the zoom ladder (data-testid live-tier-ladder) the "Planet" button has aria-pressed="true"
Click "Ship" in the zoom ladder (data-testid live-tier-ladder) without picking a ship first
Assert a note (data-testid live-ship-tier-note) says "Pick a ship first", and the tier box (data-testid live-tier) still has data-tier "planet"

Assert, within 30 seconds, the card "Busiest seas in this frame" (data-testid live-busiest-seas) lists at least 3 rows (data-testid live-busiest-sea), each with a sea name and a whole number of ships, the first row's number being the largest
Remember the first row's sea name, then click that row and wait 3 seconds for the camera to fly down

Assert the tier box (data-testid live-tier) now has data-tier "sea", the breadcrumb (data-testid live-breadcrumb) reads "World" then the remembered sea name, the sea card (data-testid live-sea-card) is titled with that sea name and shows a whole number (data-testid live-sea-ship-count), and the URL query holds tier=sea
Click "Planet" in the zoom ladder (data-testid live-tier-ladder) and wait 3 seconds
Assert the tier box (data-testid live-tier) has data-tier "planet" again, the URL query no longer holds tier, and the card "Busiest seas in this frame" (data-testid live-busiest-seas) is shown
Navigate to /live?tier=sea&at=20.63,59.63 and wait up to 60 seconds for the globe (data-testid live-globe-view) to reach data-state "ready"

Assert the tier box (data-testid live-tier) has data-tier "sea", the breadcrumb (data-testid live-breadcrumb) reads "World" then "Baltic Sea", and the sea card (data-testid live-sea-card) lists "Gulf of Finland" under "Recorded every minute here"
Click the "Gulf of Finland" row in the sea card (data-testid live-sea-region-gulf-of-finland) and wait 3 seconds

Assert the tier box (data-testid live-tier) has data-tier "strait", the "Strait" button of the zoom ladder has aria-pressed="true", and the breadcrumb (data-testid live-breadcrumb) reads "World", "Baltic Sea", "Gulf of Finland"
